attributes.content: The Boswell Sisters on the Radio
From 1931 the Boswells were a prime draw on the Woodbury’s cosmetics variety show on CBS, where their rhythmic arrangements reached millions each week.
Many of the broadcast transcriptions survive. Together with their commercial Victor and Brunswick sides, they document a sound no vocal group had made before and few have attempted since.
